title: Orel
summary: Orel refers to various geographical locations, vehicles, and cultural references, with notable connections to Ukraine through the Oril river.

sections.heading: Geographical Locations
paragraphs: Orel (Chrudim District) is a municipality and village located in the Pardubice Region of the Czech Republic.
Orel is also the name of a village situated in the Sveti Nikole Municipality of North Macedonia.
In Russia, Orel (Oryol) encompasses several inhabited localities, including Lake Orel in Khabarovsk Krai.
Additionally, Orel Township is found in Wayne County, Illinois.

sections.heading: Vehicles
paragraphs: The term Orel is associated with a Russian crewed spacecraft currently under development.
It also refers to the Antey-Class SSGN 'Orel', which is a guided missile submarine.

sections.heading: Cultural References
paragraphs: Orel (movement) denotes a Moravian/Czech youth movement and gymnastics organization.
The name Orel is used in various contexts, including as a nickname for the French rapper and songwriter Orelsan.
Orel Anzio represents an Italian Baseball League club.
The Project 1153 Orel refers to a Soviet aircraft carrier project.

sections.heading: Connection to Ukraine
paragraphs: In the [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] context, Oril (Ukrainian: Оріль; Russian: Орель, Orel') is a river that flows through [[ukraine|Ukraine]], highlighting the significance of the name Orel in the region.
